title: i cant remake my forgotten password
body:
I would like Apple Notes to have a secure recovery option for locked notes when users forget their password. Currently, resetting the Notes password does not unlock old notes, and many users lose important information permanently.

Please consider adding optional recovery methods such as:

* recovery through trusted Apple devices
* encrypted iCloud recovery
* stronger password warning messages
* improved password hint systems

The current system is too unforgiving for long-term users.

title: Use this and lose your notes
body: I have used notes for years, but it ends now. I got a new iPad and an apple pencil a year ago and have had issues since then. The iPad starts heating up quite quickly and the writing starts lagging really badly after you have written about a single page. Today I wrote notes the whole day, switched between apps and kept on taking notes. After that I put my iPad away for a few hours to charge it and came back to it after. Opened notes and started writing again and suddenly it crashed. When I opened it again, half of the notes were gone. And no kidding I have the iCloud sync on and stated that it had been backed up 3 hours ago. Well it definitely did not backup my notes. And did not save them locally even though have switched between the browser and the notes app. There is no way to return my notes and I’m mildly put, really upset. Just changed to GoodNotes and hoping it will perform better. Even one star is too much for this app. If this is your native note-taking app, it should work with your product properly. If you can’t make it perform well with an apple pen, don’t offer that option.
